accounting.rationale: Informative note/example material listing common simply contiguous sections and stating that all simply contiguous designators designate contiguous objects. The normative iff predicates are in p1-p3; this note supplies no independent requirement or diagnostic duty.

requirements.title: A section-subscript list specifies a simply contiguous section exactly under the no-vector colon-prefix conditions
requirements.definition: A section-subscript-list specifies a simply contiguous section if and only if it has no vector subscript, all but the last subscript-triplet is a colon, the last subscript-triplet has no stride, and no subscript-triplet is preceded by a section-subscript that is a subscript.

pending.no-vector-subscript: PENDING positive/negative source plan: compare a(1:3,2) or a(:,2) with a([1,2],2) on same explicit-shape array. Oracle is source classification for simple contiguity plus a literal value use in a context requiring simply contiguous if available. The vector case violation is attributable to S9.5.4-001 and not to C929 because vector type/rank/bounds are valid.
pending.all-but-last-triplets-are-colons: PENDING positive-control source shape: rank-three section a(:,:,2:4) where earlier triplets are colons and last triplet has no stride. Independent oracle is SHAPE from declared bounds. Non-vacuous because changing the first triplet to 1:2 makes the list fail only this bullet.
pending.last-triplet-has-no-stride: PENDING positive/negative source plan: a(:,1:4) satisfies the no-stride bullet, while a(:,1:4:2) violates S9.5.4-001 with valid triplet semantics. Oracle is source classification; value oracle uses SHAPE/SUM only as a non-vacuous control, not as contiguity proof.
pending.no-triplet-preceded-by-scalar-subscript: PENDING positive/negative source plan: for rank-three a, the section-subscript-list (:,1:3,2) satisfies this bullet because the only section-subscript preceding the 1:3 triplet is the colon triplet, not a subscript, while both (:,2,1:3) and (2,:,1:3) place a scalar subscript before a triplet and therefore fail it. The positive control must also satisfy the other two bullets, so all but the last triplet is a colon and the last triplet has no stride. Every list here has three section-subscripts for the same rank-three array, so no source is invalidated instead by the 9.4.2 C913 rank accounting; use coordinate-coded literals to keep each source otherwise legal and non-vacuous.
pending.iff-negative-controls: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source plan for each failed bullet: use a context whose owner requires a simply contiguous actual or variable, with a minimal repair satisfying the failed bullet and a literal side-effect oracle. No future negative may also violate vector rank/type, triplet syntax, or unrelated argument association rules.

requirements.title: An array designator is simply contiguous exactly for specified object-name, structure-component, or array-section forms
requirements.definition: An array designator is simply contiguous if and only if it is an object-name with CONTIGUOUS, an object-name that is not a pointer, not assumed-shape, and not assumed-rank, a structure-component whose final part-name is an array and either has CONTIGUOUS or is not a pointer, or an array section satisfying all listed section predicates: not a complex-part-designator, no substring-range, final part-ref nonzero rank, rightmost part-name has CONTIGUOUS or is neither assumed-shape nor pointer, and no section-subscript-list or a section-subscript-list that specifies a simply contiguous section.

pending.contiguous-object-name: PENDING positive-control source shape: declare CONTIGUOUS array object in a context where that attribute is permitted and use the object-name as an array designator. Independent oracle is a literal value operation proving the designator is the intended object; contiguity classification is source-reviewed, not inferred from address arithmetic.
pending.ordinary-object-name: PENDING positive-control source shape: explicit-shape local array object-name with no POINTER, assumed-shape, or assumed-rank property. Oracle is SHAPE/literal SUM to show the whole object is used. Non-vacuous because parallel pointer and assumed-shape declarations are separate negative controls.
pending.structure-component-final-array: PENDING positive-control source shape: scalar parent with final array component c, one not POINTER or explicitly CONTIGUOUS, use parent%c. Oracle is SHAPE/literal SUM from component values. Non-vacuous because a pointer final component without CONTIGUOUS is the controlled failure.
pending.array-section-excludes-complex-part: PENDING negative-control source plan attributable to S9.5.4-002: complex array part designator z%re as array section is otherwise valid by 9.4.4/9.5.3.1 but fails simple contiguity under this bullet. Repair to a noncomplex numeric array section and use literal SUM as non-vacuous control.
pending.array-section-excludes-substring-range: PENDING negative-control source plan attributable to S9.5.4-002: CHARACTER array section c(:)(1:2) has a substring-range and otherwise valid character substring semantics. Repair by removing substring-range or using a whole character element length section, with literal character oracle. Do not attribute to C926 when character type is valid.
pending.array-section-final-part-ref-nonzero-ran: PENDING positive/negative source plan: final part-ref section a(:) satisfies nonzero rank, while a nonfinal array parent with final scalar component tests failure of this bullet if other 9.5.3.1 rules permit the section. Oracle is SHAPE from the nonzero final part and source classification for the negative.
pending.array-section-rightmost-part-contiguous-: PENDING source plan: compare rightmost part-name with CONTIGUOUS or ordinary explicit-shape property against an assumed-shape or pointer rightmost part without CONTIGUOUS. Literal component values prove non-vacuous use; failure is attributed to this S9.5.4-002 bullet only after dependent declarations are valid.
pending.array-section-list-condition: PENDING source plan: array section with no section-subscript-list or with a p1 simply contiguous list is positive; section with a p1-failing list is negative. Independent oracle is SHAPE/SUM for selected elements; simple contiguity classification is by source predicates, not by address arithmetic.

requirements.title: An array variable is simply contiguous exactly when its designator is simply contiguous or it is a contiguous pointer function reference
requirements.definition: An array variable is simply contiguous if and only if it is a simply contiguous array designator or a reference to a function that returns a pointer with the CONTIGUOUS attribute.

pending.array-variable-from-simply-contiguous-de: PENDING positive-control source shape: use an explicit-shape array variable or p2-qualified section as an array variable in a context that depends on source-level simple contiguity. Literal assignment/SUM oracle proves variable use. Non-vacuous because an otherwise identical p2-failing section is a negative control.
pending.contiguous-pointer-function-reference: PENDING positive-control source shape: function returns an array pointer with CONTIGUOUS attribute and is referenced as an array variable where permitted. Oracle is literal values assigned through the pointer result or a side-effect status independent of compiler agreement. Non-vacuous because removing CONTIGUOUS is the paired negative.
pending.noncontiguous-designator-negative-contro: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source plan attributable through S9.5.4-003 to S9.5.4-002: use an array variable designator that fails simple-contiguity predicates in a context requiring simply contiguous. Repair only the failed p2 predicate and observe literal control result. No unrelated argument association rule should be the primary violation.
pending.noncontiguous-pointer-function-negative-: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source plan attributable to S9.5.4-003: function returns an array pointer without CONTIGUOUS where a simply contiguous array variable is required. Repair by adding CONTIGUOUS to the pointer result and observe literal side effect. Ensure pointer function syntax and target association are otherwise valid.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_091.json reads all four original 9.5.4 units in full and confirms the three section-subscript-list bullets for a simply contiguous section, the five array-designator alternatives of p2 and the simply contiguous array variable of p3, with CONTIGUOUS, pointer, assumed-shape and assumed-rank conditions left owned by 8.5.x. Two blocking findings were raised and closed before this record: C9SR2-001 removed a positive control that itself violated the very bullet it was meant to support, and C9SR2-002 removed a negative whose rank-two list was already invalid on a rank-three array under the 9.4.2 C913 rank accounting rather than under this requirement. All17 facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
